# Lighting

38 tools. Back to the [index](README.md).

## `configure_light_shadows`

Configure shadow settings for a light actor using preset shadow qualities. Enabled/Disabled switch cast shadows; High, Medium and Low also set ShadowBias, ShadowSlopeBias and ShadowSharpen (0.1/0.1/1.0, 0.2/0.2/0.5, 0.5/0.5/0.0). Everything is read back from the light; it does not touch whether the light affects the world.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Name of the light actor to configure |
| `shadow_settings` | string | yes | Shadow configuration: 'Enabled', 'Disabled', 'High', 'Medium', or 'Low' (case-insensitive); any other name is an error |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, shadow_settings, shadows_configured, shadow_message, old_cast_shadows, new_cast_shadows, old_affect_world, new_affect_world, shadows_enabled, affect_world, bias_applied, shadow_bias, shadow_slope_bias, shadow_filter_sharpen, light_enabled, light_intensity, light_mobility, light_type, light_atmosphere_sun_light, light_cascade_distribution_exponent, light_cascade_transition_fraction, light_attenuation_radius, light_source_radius, light_source_length, light_inner_cone_angle, light_outer_cone_angle, x, y, z, r, g, b, a }`

## `get_directional_light_cascade_settings`

Read the seven Cascaded Shadow Map (CSM) settings of a directional light: dynamic shadow distance (movable/stationary), cascade count, distribution exponent, transition fraction, distance-fadeout fraction, and per-object inset shadows for movable objects. Round-trips set_directional_light_cascade_settings. Errors honestly if the actor is not a directional light.

## `set_directional_light_cascade_settings`

Configure Cascaded Shadow Map (CSM) settings on a directional light: dynamic shadow distance (movable/stationary), cascade count, distribution exponent, transition fraction, distance-fadeout fraction, and per-object inset shadows for movable objects. Partial update (idempotent): only fields present are written; the engine setters auto-dedup, and the inset-shadows bit (no setter) is guarded by hand. Errors honestly if the actor is not a directional light. Verify by read-back (every field is echoed) or via get_directional_light_cascade_settings.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Name of the directional light actor to modify |
| `dynamic_shadow_distance_movable` | number | no | How far CSM dynamic shadows cover for a movable light, measured from the camera (0 disables) |
| `dynamic_shadow_distance_stationary` | number | no | How far CSM dynamic shadows cover for a stationary light, measured from the camera (0 disables) |
| `num_dynamic_shadow_cascades` | number | no | Number of cascades the view frustum is split into for the whole-scene dynamic shadow |
| `cascade_distribution_exponent` | number | no | Distributes cascades closer (larger) or farther (smaller) from the camera |
| `cascade_transition_fraction` | number | no | Proportion of the blended fade region between cascades (0 = hard transitions) |
| `shadow_distance_fadeout_fraction` | number | no | Size of the fade-out region at the far extent of the dynamic shadow, as a fraction of the shadow distance |
| `use_inset_shadows_for_movable_objects` | boolean | no | Stationary lights: use per-object inset shadows for movable components even though CSM is enabled |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, light_subtype, settings_applied: {...}, applied_count, dynamic_shadow_distance_movable, dynamic_shadow_distance_stationary, num_dynamic_shadow_cascades, cascade_distribution_exponent, cascade_transition_fraction, shadow_distance_fadeout_fraction, use_inset_shadows_for_movable_objects }`

Only the supplied fields change (applied_count counts them) and the reply reads every property back. Colors are [R,G,B] or [R,G,B,A].

## `set_light_properties`

Set component-level light properties: attenuation radius, source radius/length, cone angles, color temperature, indirect/volumetric intensity, translucent lighting, plus RectLight source size + barn doors + source texture, IES profile (texture/brightness scale/use-brightness), light-function (material/scale/fade distance/disabled brightness), shadow bias, cast/volumetric shadow, contact-shadow length (+ world-space flag), and inverse-squared falloff. Round-trips with get_light_properties. Partial update (idempotent): only fields present are written; a field that doesn't apply to the light's type returns an honest note instead of an error. Verify by read-back via get_light_properties (light_* keys).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Name of the light actor to modify. |
| `attenuation_radius` | number | no | float, light reach — local lights only (Point/Spot/Rect). |
| `source_radius` | number | no | float, soft source radius (Point/Spot). |
| `soft_source_radius` | number | no | float (Point/Spot). |
| `source_length` | number | no | float, line-source length (Point/Spot). |
| `inner_cone_angle` | number | no | float degrees (Spot only). |
| `outer_cone_angle` | number | no | float degrees (Spot only). |
| `temperature` | number | no | float Kelvin color temperature (all lights; pair with use_temperature). |
| `use_temperature` | boolean | no | bool, enable color temperature (all lights). |
| `indirect_lighting_intensity` | number | no | float (all lights). |
| `volumetric_scattering_intensity` | number | no | float (all lights). |
| `affect_translucent_lighting` | boolean | no | bool (all lights). |
| `ies_texture` | string | no | asset path to a UTextureLightProfile (IES profile); omit/empty leaves it unchanged (all lights). |
| `use_ies_brightness` | boolean | no | bool, use the IES profile's brightness (all lights). |
| `ies_brightness_scale` | number | no | float, IES brightness multiplier (all lights). |
| `light_function_material` | string | no | asset path to a UMaterialInterface light-function material; omit/empty leaves it unchanged (all lights). |
| `light_function_scale` | array | no | [x,y,z] float array, light-function projection scale (all lights). |
| `light_function_fade_distance` | number | no | float, distance at which the light function fades out (all lights). |
| `light_function_disabled_brightness` | number | no | float, brightness where the light function is faded out (all lights). |
| `shadow_bias` | number | no | float, dynamic-shadow depth bias (all lights). |
| `cast_shadows` | boolean | no | bool, whether the light casts shadows (all lights). |
| `cast_volumetric_shadow` | boolean | no | bool, whether the light casts volumetric (beam) shadows (all lights). |
| `contact_shadow_length` | number | no | float, screen-space contact-shadow ray length (all lights). |
| `contact_shadow_length_in_ws` | boolean | no | bool, interpret contact_shadow_length in world space instead of screen space (all lights). |
| `use_inverse_squared_falloff` | boolean | no | bool, physically-based inverse-square falloff (Point/Spot). |
| `falloff_exponent` | number | no | float, manual falloff exponent when inverse-squared is off (Point/Spot). |
| `source_width` | number | no | float, RectLight emissive width (Rect only). |
| `source_height` | number | no | float, RectLight emissive height (Rect only). |
| `barn_door_angle` | number | no | float degrees, RectLight barn-door opening angle (Rect only). |
| `barn_door_length` | number | no | float, RectLight barn-door length (Rect only). |
| `source_texture` | string | no | asset path to a UTexture for the RectLight surface; omit/empty leaves it unchanged (Rect only). |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, light_subtype, settings_applied: {...}, notes: [string], applied_count }`

## `set_lumen_gi_quality`

Applies Lumen / global-illumination scene tuning via console variables.  Provide exactly one of:     quality: "Low" | "Medium" | "High" | "Epic" | "Cinematic"         -> sg.GlobalIlluminationQuality (scalability group 0..4), read back.     method:  "Lumen" | "ScreenSpace" | "None"         -> r.DynamicGlobalIlluminationMethod (0=None,1=Lumen,2=ScreenSpace), read back.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quality` | string | no | One of "Low" \| "Medium" \| "High" \| "Epic" \| "Cinematic" (mutually exclusive with method) |
| `method` | string | no | One of "Lumen" \| "ScreenSpace" \| "None" (mutually exclusive with quality) |

**Returns:** `{ mode: string, cvar: string, requested_method: string?, requested_quality: string?, requested_value: number, value: number, applied: bool }`

## `set_post_process_color_grading`

Set the global AND per-range (shadows/midtones/highlights) color-grading wheels plus white balance and the range pivots on a PostProcessVolume.  Each wheel is an FVector4 [R, G, B, master]; white balance and pivots are scalars — set_post_process_setting never covered these. Setting a field also turns on its bOverride flag (so it takes effect) and reads the value back. Only the supplied fields change.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label/name of the target PostProcessVolume actor. |
| `saturation` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] saturation (default master 1.0; neutral is [1,1,1,1]). |
| `contrast` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] contrast (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `gamma` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] gamma (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `gain` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] gain (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `offset` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] offset (default master 0.0; neutral is [0,0,0,0]). |
| `saturation_shadows` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] saturation for the shadows range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `saturation_midtones` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] saturation for the midtones range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `saturation_highlights` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] saturation for the highlights range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `contrast_shadows` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] contrast for the shadows range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `contrast_midtones` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] contrast for the midtones range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `contrast_highlights` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] contrast for the highlights range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `white_temp` | number | no | Optional white balance temperature (Kelvin, e.g. 6500 neutral). |
| `white_tint` | number | no | Optional white balance tint. |
| `shadows_max` | number | no | Optional pivot: upper bound of the shadows range. |
| `highlights_min` | number | no | Optional pivot: lower bound of the highlights range. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, settings_applied: object (wheels as arrays, white_temp/white_tint/shadows_max/highlights_min as numbers), applied_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `set_post_process_setting`

Sets a post-process setting on a PostProcessVolume (sets bOverride flag + field, reads back).          exposure (auto_exposure_bias), exposure_min, exposure_max, exposure_method         (0=Histogram,1=Basic,2=Manual), lumen_gi / dynamic_global_illumination_method         (0=None,1=Lumen,2=ScreenSpace,3=Plugin)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label/name of the target PostProcessVolume actor |
| `setting` | string | yes | One of: bloom_intensity, vignette_intensity, ambient_occlusion_intensity, |
| `value` | number | yes | Numeric value to apply (enum index for method/gi settings) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, setting: string, canonical_setting: string, requested_value: number, applied_value: number, applied: bool }`

## `set_post_process_volume_settings`

Set the FPostProcessSettings struct of an APostProcessVolume. Each field is optional; only the fields present in the Params JSON are applied. Marks the actor dirty + adds a FScopedTransaction so it can be undone. bloom_intensity/ambient_occlusion_intensity/vignette_intensity are set through set_post_process_setting, not here (one code path per field).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `volume_name` | string | yes | Label of the APostProcessVolume. |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | Optional bool (PPV bEnabled). |
| `priority` | string | no | Optional float (PPV Priority). |
| `film_grain_intensity` | string | no | Optional float. |
| `motion_blur_amount` | string | no | Optional float. |

**Returns:** `{ volume_name, applied_count, applied_fields: [string] }`

## `set_reflection_capture_properties`

Set properties on an existing reflection-capture actor (Sphere or Box). Dispatches by the actor's concrete capture-component class; a sphere-only param on a box (or vice versa) is a no-op and reports its &lt;prop>_set=false. box_extent maps to the actor scale (the box capture has no extent UPROPERTY; its size derives from the transform scale). cubemap loads a UTextureCube by path and flips ReflectionSourceType to SpecifiedCubemap. Marks the capture dirty for recapture; reads every set property back.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or internal name of the reflection-capture actor |
| `influence_radius` | number | no | Sphere capture InfluenceRadius in cm (Sphere only) |
| `box_transition_distance` | number | no | Box capture BoxTransitionDistance (Box only) |
| `brightness` | number | no | Capture Brightness multiplier (clamped to [0.5, 4]) |
| `box_extent` | array | no | Box capture extent as actor scale [X, Y, Z] (Box only; SetActorScale3D) |
| `cubemap` | string | no | Path to a UTextureCube; assigning it sets ReflectionSourceType=SpecifiedCubemap |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, actor_internal_name: string, capture_type: string, influence_radius_set: bool, influence_radius: number, box_transition_distance_set: bool, box_transition_distance: number, brightness_set: bool, brightness: number, box_extent_set: bool, box_extent: [number], cubemap_set: bool, cubemap: string, reflection_source_type: string, marked_dirty: bool }`

## `set_scene_capture_2d_properties`

Set data-only properties on an existing SceneCapture2D actor's USceneCaptureComponent2D: CaptureSource (base), ProjectionType, FOVAngle, TextureTarget (UTextureRenderTarget2D by path) and bCaptureEveryFrame (base). Headless-safe: configures fields only, never triggers a GPU capture. Reads every set property back.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or internal name of the SceneCapture2D actor |
| `capture_source` | string | no | ESceneCaptureSource (e.g. SceneColorHDR \| FinalColorLDR \| FinalColorHDR \| SceneDepth); the SCS_ prefix is optional |
| `projection_type` | string | no | Perspective \| Orthographic |
| `fov_angle` | number | no | Field-of-view angle in degrees (FOVAngle field) |
| `texture_target` | string | no | Path to a UTextureRenderTarget2D to assign |
| `capture_every_frame` | boolean | no | Whether the component captures every frame (bCaptureEveryFrame) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, actor_internal_name: string, capture_source_set: bool, capture_source: string, projection_type_set: bool, projection_type: string, fov_angle_set: bool, fov_angle: number, texture_target_set: bool, texture_target: string, has_render_target: bool, capture_every_frame_set: bool, capture_every_frame: bool }`

## `set_sky_atmosphere_properties`

Set the atmosphere properties of a SkyAtmosphere actor's USkyAtmosphereComponent. Only the supplied fields change (applied_count counts them) and the reply reads every property back. Colors are [R,G,B] or [R,G,B,A].

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label/name of the target SkyAtmosphere actor. |
| `rayleigh_scattering` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B(,A)] Rayleigh scattering color. |
| `rayleigh_scattering_scale` | number | no | Optional Rayleigh scattering scale. |
| `mie_scattering` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B(,A)] Mie scattering color. |
| `mie_scattering_scale` | number | no | Optional Mie scattering scale. |
| `mie_anisotropy` | number | no | Optional Mie anisotropy (0..1). |
| `ground_albedo` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B] ground albedo as 0-255 bytes (FColor). |
| `bottom_radius` | number | no | Optional planet bottom radius (km). |
| `atmosphere_height` | number | no | Optional atmosphere height (km). |
| `multi_scattering_factor` | number | no | Optional multi-scattering factor (0..2). |
| `aerial_perspective_view_distance_scale` | number | no | Optional aerial perspective view distance scale. |
| `height_fog_contribution` | number | no | Optional height fog contribution (0..1). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, properties: object, applied_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `set_sky_light_properties`

Set the properties of a SkyLight actor's USkyLightComponent: intensity, light color, indirect and volumetric intensity, lower-hemisphere color and occlusion. Only the supplied fields change (applied_count counts them) and the reply reads every property back. Colors are [R,G,B] or [R,G,B,A].

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label/name of the target SkyLight actor. |
| `intensity` | number | no | Optional sky light intensity. |
| `light_color` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B(,A)] light color (stored as FColor). |
| `indirect_lighting_intensity` | number | no | Optional indirect lighting intensity scale. |
| `volumetric_scattering_intensity` | number | no | Optional volumetric scattering intensity. |
| `lower_hemisphere_color` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B(,A)] lower-hemisphere color (FLinearColor). |
| `occlusion_tint` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B] occlusion tint as 0-255 bytes (FColor). |
| `occlusion_contrast` | number | no | Optional AO contrast (0..1). |
| `occlusion_exponent` | number | no | Optional AO exponent. |
| `min_occlusion` | number | no | Optional minimum occlusion (0..1). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, properties: object, applied_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `set_volumetric_cloud_properties`

Set the properties of a VolumetricCloud actor's UVolumetricCloudComponent: layer and planet geometry, ground albedo, tracing distances and sample counts. Only the supplied fields change (applied_count counts them) and the reply reads every property back. ground_albedo is [R,G,B] in 0-255 bytes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label/name of the target VolumetricCloud actor. |
| `layer_bottom_altitude` | number | no | Optional layer bottom altitude (km). |
| `layer_height` | number | no | Optional layer height (km). |
| `planet_radius` | number | no | Optional planet radius (km). |
| `ground_albedo` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B] ground albedo as 0-255 bytes (FColor). |
| `tracing_start_max_distance` | number | no | Optional tracing start max distance. |
| `tracing_max_distance` | number | no | Optional tracing max distance. |
| `sky_light_cloud_bottom_occlusion` | number | no | Optional sky light cloud bottom occlusion (0..1). |
| `view_sample_count_scale` | number | no | Optional view sample count scale. |
| `shadow_view_sample_count_scale` | number | no | Optional shadow view sample count scale. |
| `shadow_tracing_distance` | number | no | Optional shadow tracing distance (km). |
| `stop_tracing_transmittance_threshold` | number | no | Optional stop-tracing transmittance threshold. |
| `use_per_sample_atmospheric_light_transmittance` | boolean | no | Optional per-sample atmospheric light transmittance. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, properties: object, applied_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `update_reflection_captures`

Rebuilds reflection-capture contents for all captures in the editor world.  Marks every reflection capture dirty and runs the canonical editor rebuild path (UReflectionCaptureComponent::UpdateReflectionCaptureContents).

No parameters.

**Returns:** `{ updated: bool, capture_count: number }`
